tbesh_html:
Beth-horon = "house of hollowness"
Lower Beth-horon-town located 800 feet (245 m) lower than Upper Beth-horon on the mountains of Ephraim
Combined with bet cho.ron (בֵּית חוֹרֹן "Beth-horon" H1032)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H2356 (חוֹר); house of hollowness;
